meta.author: OpenMedia
meta.summary: Hides Spotify's sign-up bar and Premium promos; blur or hide cover art; dim or hide home shelves
meta.notes:
Checked 2026-11-13, logged out, real Chrome (headless): iPhone UA 390x844 and desktop UA on open.spotify.com (home), DOM captured after 7 seconds. Fixtures `real.html` and `desktop-real.html` are sanitised excerpts of that DOM (text stripped, only needed ancestors, `data-keep` on main view, Log in button, player controls and the phone tab bar).

LIVE desktop: `[data-testid="signup-bar"]` 1, `#global-nav-bar a[href="/download"]` 1, `[data-testid="card-image"]` 54, `[data-testid="component-shelf"]` 5, `[data-testid="left-sidebar-footer"]` 1, Log in and Sign up buttons 1 each. LIVE phone: `[data-testid="premium-banner"]` 1, `[data-testid="home-card"] img` 84, `[data-testid="carousel-mwp"]` 5, `[data-testid="masthead-footer"]` 1. The original cookie rule matched `#onetrust-consent-sdk` and its banner (2) on both; ad and app-banner rules matched nothing.

Choices: Cover art Show/Blur/Hide; Home shelves Show/Dim/Hide. The selectors use Spotify's data-testid attributes; the generated class names are hashed and are not used.

NOT verified: logged-in player; album, artist and playlist pages (track-list covers, artist headers); the language modal (left alone); the Premium, Support and Download buttons in the top bar (no stable attribute, text only, so not touched); non-English locales for aria labels (none are used).
